name: Shin Moshi Onna no Ko ni Nattara Nani kara Yaru ka ~Danshikou Saigo no 5-kakan~
original_name: 新もし女の子になったらナニからやるか～男子校最後の5日間～
source:
After he played a game he purchased in a shop, a change happened to his body...
The last 5 days that Yona, who became a girl, spends in the school for boys.
Yona gradually learns to use the weapon of the female and deal with men.
This is a heartwarming story of a sex-reversed boy in school.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049666.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当他玩完在商店购买的游戏后，他的身体发生了变化……
成为女孩的尤娜在男孩学校度过的最后5天。
尤娜逐渐学会使用女性的武器来对付男性。
这是一个发生在学校里的性反转男孩的感人故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049666.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
